ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply; see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This course is for students in the Springfield cohort. The site-based course beings May 5 and ends June 25. Class sessions will be held on Tuesday and Thursday evenings from 6:00 to 9:30 PM at the University of Illinois at Springfield campus. The May 5 and May 12 classes will be held in room 112 in the Human Resources Building (HRB). All other class sessions will be held in the Radio Station Building (WUIS) in room 22. Two sections of this course have been created to handle the large number of students admitted to the Springfield cohort. If you are unable to enroll in this course section because of a capacity error, submit a registration for the SOCW 400 S1 section. The email address for the instructor is sharvahamptoncampbell@yahoo.com
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: OCE Tuition $372.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $41.00 per Bill Hour.
